revisions.scientific_question: In the FireFlow room flow field, analyze connected high-speed regions, taking speed as the Euclidean magnitude of the stored uvw vector at each point. Choose and explain a threshold or percentile rule for finite non-zero speeds, a connectivity rule, a regional strength statistic, and how to represent a region’s location. Report the location and strength of the strongest region.
revisions.reason: Remove an unintended flow-quantity choice while preserving the frozen speed scope and all four open operationalization dimensions.
